violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON MOP SINK FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is require. by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED APPROVED MOP SPLITTER INFORMATION (HYDRO SYSTEMS 1951 PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE) TO CFM. CFM ORDERED PART AND WILL PROVIDE PROOF OF INSTALLATION TO EHS.
